identity-aiops 0.1.0 (Initial Release)

- Preview release offering governed, mock-validated identity operations for Keycloak and authentik.
- Provides a unified toolset for user, group, event, client, and audit analysis—27 tools in total.
- Includes four flagship root-cause analyses (login-failure/lockout storm, stale access, client misconfiguration, MFA coverage).
- Risk-tiered and auditable write operations (disable/enable user, revoke sessions, password reset, client secret rotation, redirect URI changes) with undo and approval gates.
- Credentials are encrypted on disk with Fernet/scrypt; no plaintext storage or logging.
- All actions are audited locally; no live IdP connection—preview/mock only.
